title: Cascade Ortho Rider Schedule of Benefits — Lifetime Maximum, Coinsurance and Deductible
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders: benefit levels by rider.**

| Rider | Lifetime orthodontic maximum per person (USD) | Coinsurance, participating practice (percent of allowed case fee) | Coinsurance, non-participating practice (percent of out-of-network allowed case fee) | Allowed case fee for a non-participating practice | Lifetime orthodontic deductible per person (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 | 1000.00 | 50 | 40 | 70th percentile of Cascade usual and customary | 0.00 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1500 | 1500.00 | 50 | 50 | 80th percentile of Cascade usual and customary | 0.00 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 2000 | 2000.00 | 50 | 50 | 80th percentile of Cascade usual and customary | 0.00 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500 | 1500.00 | 50 | 40 | 70th percentile of Cascade usual and customary | 50.00 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 2000 | 2000.00 | 50 | 50 | 80th percentile of Cascade usual and customary | 50.00 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 3000 | 3000.00 | 60 | 50 | 90th percentile of Cascade usual and customary | 0.00 |

## What each column means

- **Lifetime orthodontic maximum:** the most Cascade pays for one person's orthodontic treatment across every Cascade orthodontic rider that person has ever held.
- **Coinsurance:** a whole-number percentage of the allowed case fee that the rider pays. The participating rate applies when the treating practice is participating. The non-participating rate applies to the out-of-network allowed case fee.
- **Allowed case fee for a non-participating practice:** the Cascade usual-and-customary percentile used as the allowed case fee.
- **Lifetime deductible:** an amount per person, for life. It is taken once from the allowed case fee of the first case, before coinsurance. 0.00 means there is no deductible.
- **Benefit basis (the same on every rider):** the case benefit is the lesser of the coinsured fee and the remaining lifetime maximum.

*Hypothetical reading:* on a rider with a 50.00 deductible and 50 percent participating coinsurance, a first case with an allowed case fee of 4,210.00 gives a coinsured fee of 2,080.00 (4,210.00 less 50.00, times 50 percent). That coinsured fee is then compared with the person's remaining lifetime maximum.
